note: The single rules folder for VyralX production (cluster B131). Before this artifact the rules existed only scattered as code (format_clone.score_hook, shorts_factory._HOOK_TEMPLATES, packaging lints). Every generating or assembling step consults THIS folder; the checker in app/services/production_rules.py measures a plan against it. Rule statements are the source creator's, as recovered from the full watch of DeyusrQMOmi; thresholds are the measured forms of those statements.

rules.source: DeyusrQMOmi (senior motion designer's rules, per the creator's narration)
rules.statement: Grab attention in the first second — the video is hooked in the first second.

rules.enforcement: app/services/production_rules.py:check_plan (every visual carries an 'at' on the voice timeline)
rules.statement: Time the visuals to the voice — every visual event is anchored to the narration timeline.

rules.source: DeyusrQMOmi; word-timing pattern's second source (first: DdlIP2YAqsq, ~250ms word-landing)
rules.statement: Land pictures exactly on words — a visual lands on the word it illustrates.

rules.source: DeyusrQMOmi ('hooked in the first second and moving until the last')
rules.statement: Keep moving until the last — visuals move until the final frame, no dead tail.

rules.source: DeyusrQMOmi (the folder's workflow: animate frames, then review every frame at 60fps before publishing)
rules.statement: Review every frame at 60fps before publishing.
